name: Little Lamb
source:
You find yourself in the middle of a forest talking to someone you don't know?
A story reminiscent of Little Red Riding Hood although something has gone horribly wrong...

[From [url=https://pikachip.itch.io/little-lamb]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己身处森林深处，正与一个不认识的人交谈？
这个故事令人想起《小红帽》，可似乎有什么地方出了可怕的差错……

[摘自[url=https://pikachip.itch.io/little-lamb]itch.io[/url]]
